title: Add retries to a urlopen call to not be annoyed after it's been running for a while :)
description: Add retries to a urlopen call to not be annoyed after it's been running for a while :)
diff:
diff --git a/scripts-for-cards/release-updates.py b/scripts-for-cards/release-updates.py
index 256bb7b..ad244c5 100755
--- a/scripts-for-cards/release-updates.py
+++ b/scripts-for-cards/release-updates.py
@@ -16,9 +16,11 @@ from __future__ import print_function
 from contextlib import closing
 import re
 import sys
+from time import sleep
 
 try:
     from urllib.request import urlopen
+    from urllib.error import HTTPError
 except ImportError:
     from urllib2 import urlopen
 
@@ -28,6 +30,8 @@ from launchpadlib.launchpad import Launchpad
 
 changes_re = re.compile(r"lp:\s+\#\d+(?:,\s*\#\d+)*", re.I)
 bug_re = re.compile(r"\#(\d+)")
+url_open_retries = 30
+url_open_initial_delay = 2
 
 if sys.version >= "3":
     # Force encoding to UTF-8 even in non-UTF-8 locales.
@@ -196,8 +200,13 @@ pubs.reverse()
 for pub in pubs:
     changes_file_url = pub.changesFileUrl()
     # print('', pub.component_name, pub.source_package_name, pub.source_package_version, pub.date_published, changes_file_url)
-    with closing(urlopen(changes_file_url)) as changes_handle:
-        changes = deb822.Changes(changes_handle.read())
+    for retry in range(url_open_retries):
+        try:
+            with closing(urlopen(changes_file_url)) as changes_handle:
+                changes = deb822.Changes(changes_handle.read())
+            break
+        except HTTPError:
+            sleep(retry * url_open_initial_delay)
     accum = ""
     for line in changes["changes"].splitlines():
         if not line.startswith("  "):
